fatha.name: Fatha
fatha.description: A small diagonal line above a letter. Represents a short 'a' vowel.

kasra.name: Kasra
kasra.description: A small diagonal line below a letter. Represents a short 'i' vowel.

damma.name: Damma
damma.description: A small loop (like a small Waw) above a letter. Represents a short 'u' vowel.

sukun.name: Sukun
sukun.description: A small circle above a letter indicating no vowel sound follows.

alif.name: Alif
alif.description: Alif is the first letter. It is often a long vowel 'aa'. It is a 'selfish' letter, meaning it only connects to the right.
alif.pronunciation: Long 'ā' like in 'father'. When it carries a hamza (أ / إ) it is a glottal stop.

ba.name: Ba
ba.description: Ba has a dot below. It connects from both sides.

ta.name: Ta
ta.description: Ta has two dots above. It connects from both sides.

tha.name: Tha
tha.description: Tha has three dots above. It connects from both sides.

jim.name: Jim
jim.description: Jim has a dot inside (or below in initial/medial). Connects both sides.

ha.name: Ḥa
ha.description: Ha has no dots. Connects both sides.
ha.pronunciation: Sharp, breathy 'h' from the middle of the throat, like breathing on cold hands.

kha.name: Kha
kha.description: Kha has a dot above. Connects both sides.

dal.name: Dal
dal.description: Dal sounds like D. It connects only to the right.

dhal.name: Dhal
dhal.description: Dhal sounds like TH (voiced). Dot above. Connects only to the right.

ra.name: Ra
ra.description: Ra connects only to the right.

zay.name: Zay
zay.description: Zay looks like Ra but with a dot above. Connects only to the right.

sin.name: Sin
sin.description: Sin has three 'teeth'. Connects both sides.

shin.name: Shin
shin.description: Shin has three dots above. Connects both sides.

sad.name: Sad
sad.description: Sad has a loop shape. Connects both sides.
sad.pronunciation: Heavy (emphatic) 's': tongue tip as for 's', with the back of the tongue raised.

dad.name: Dad
dad.description: Dad is like Sad but with a dot above. Connects both sides.
dad.pronunciation: Heavy (emphatic) 'd': the side of the tongue presses against the upper molars.

tah.name: Ta (Emphatic)
tah.pronunciation: Heavy (emphatic) 't': tongue tip behind the upper teeth, back of the tongue raised.

zah.name: Za (Emphatic)
zah.description: Like Ta but with a dot. Connects both sides.
zah.pronunciation: Heavy (emphatic) 'th' as in 'that': tongue tip on the edge of the upper teeth, back of the tongue raised.

ayn.name: Ayn
ayn.description: Ayn changes shape significantly in the middle/end. Connects both sides.
ayn.pronunciation: Voiced sound from the middle of the throat, made by tightening the throat.

ghayn.name: Ghayn
ghayn.description: Like Ayn but with a dot above. Connects both sides.
ghayn.pronunciation: Gargling sound from the upper throat, like French 'r'.

fa.name: Fa
fa.description: Fa has one dot above. Connects both sides.

qaf.name: Qaf
qaf.description: Qaf has two dots above. Connects both sides.
qaf.pronunciation: Deep 'q': the back of the tongue touches the soft palate (near the uvula).

ha_soft.name: Ha
ha_soft.description: Soft H. Connects both sides. Changes shape in middle/end.

ya.name: Ya
ya.description: Two dots below. Connects both sides.

fathatan.name: Fathatan
fathatan.description: Double Fatha. Makes an 'an' sound. Usually appears on an Alif at the end of a word.

kasratan.name: Kasratan
kasratan.description: Double Kasra below the letter. Makes an 'in' sound.

shadda.name: Shadda
shadda.description: A w-shaped sign above a letter. It emphasizes or doubles the consonant sound.
